name: Knitcap the Black Cat
blurb: Knitcap, a scruffy black cat with big yellow eyes and a pink nose, wears a rust-orange knit beanie and grins at the first frosty autumn morning.
look: A scruffy black house cat with yellow eyes, a pink nose, a toothy grin and a bristly puffed tail, wearing a plain rust-orange knit beanie.

name: Bristle the Yellow-Eyed Cat
blurb: Bristle, a shaggy black cat with round yellow eyes, puffs her tail up to twice its size whenever the autumn wind rattles the garden gate.

name: Nightfuzz the Beanie Cat
blurb: Nightfuzz, a fluffy black cat with golden-yellow eyes and a toothy grin, tugs an orange knit cap over one ear and waits on the fence for dawn.
